The day the TOPS executives and the Inspection Team arrived, she and Manato had just returned from school. Their airship had to circle overhead for ages, waiting for a place to land because the guests' vehicles took priority. Sweating as they hurried across the skybridge, they passed just above a throng of reporters surrounding the guests. That's when she spotted the girl. That night, she had a dream: it was her being swarmed by reporters, walking that same path under the bridge. And at the end of it... stood a throne, waiting just for her.
It had been a long time since she'd had a dream like that. She got up for a drink of water, replaying the words she'd overheard during the day: "A so-called expert Inspection Team, and they've got some rich girl tagging along just for show!"
"Kama, Kama!" She cracked open the window and whispered. A fuzzy little face popped up instantly from outside. "I've got a great idea. Tomorrow night... let's go do something fun."

Despite this move clearly exposing one's location and attracting the enemy, this is not an issue for Billy so long as everything is cool enough.

"COPY? How can you call that a copy?! I've poured all my passion, wisdom, soul, and moisture into this! Apart from summoning a shooting star to transform me — this is real deal, bona fide Starlight Knight equipment!" — Billy, enthusiastically outlining his modding philosophy
专门在与音擎的兼容性上做了算法优化的驱动盘，能够更好地发挥辅助功能。: A Drive Disc designed with algorithmic optimization for W-Engine compatibility, improving auxiliary performance.
世界不需要被毁灭再重建，也没有谁有资格这么做。\n但人可以。\n所以，他将自己打:
The world doesn't need to be destroyed and rebuilt, and no one has the right to do such.
But a person can.
So, he shattered himself and was reborn.
"If I must fall, let me fall. The person I am meant to become will surely catch me."
世界的纷纷扰扰，都是源自人心的孤寂。如果每个人的心都可以得到回音，会不会，这个世:
The turmoil in the world originates from the solitude of the human heart. If everyone's heart was reciprocated, perhaps all the suffering, sadness, and silence in the world would vanish?
If we could weave this connection with song, would all the cracks heal, and all the pain turn into a beautiful melody, filling the silence? At that point, the world would no longer be a lonely island.
"This song is dedicated to the world!"
世界皆舞台，人们总要出演自己一生的故事，她也不例外。\n她是可怜的病患，她是正义:
The world is a stage, and everyone has a part to play in the story of their life. She is no different.
She is the helpless patient and the righteous judge; a capricious executioner, a reckless adventurer; a child fascinated by everything, a strange soul indifferent to pain...
She can be anyone. But none of those people are Phoenix.
She embraces everyone but herself. She delights in death, yet has never truly known what it means to live.
But that stopped mattering long ago. The show must go on, and she has only one thing to do: choose a mask and start playing herself.
So why not play a circus clown? Always making a scene, always laughing out loud.
为街头音乐爱好者而生的定制款音擎，牺牲散热元件为昂贵的音响模块腾出空间，只为了让:
A custom-made W-Engine designed for street music lovers. It sacrifices cooling components to make space for high-end speaker modules, ensuring your fans, both Ethereal and human, hear your every word.
——From the streets to the Hollows, superstars are never short of flowers and applause. The bars they spit are so flaming hot, they add the perfect heat to any battlefield.
丽娜总是有做好任何事的自信和毁灭任何事的本领。\n不过，在毁灭敌人的好心情这件事:
Rina always has the confidence to excel at anything and the ability to annihilate everything.
However, when it comes to being in the mood to annihilate enemies, both her confidence and capability align.
丽娜，维多利亚家政的女仆长，同时也是组织资历最深的成员。\n漂亮端庄，从头到脚都:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.
乔伊斯曾随身携带的特殊设备「迷宫萝卜」的碎片。据悉，该设备十分神奇，无需罗塞塔数: A shard of Labyrinth Carrot, a special device once carried by Joyous. Rumor has it that this remarkable invention can chart routes through the Papago Hollow without relying on Rosetta Data.
事实上，即使有外形上的天然隔阂，真斗依然很受大家的欢迎。\n有人与他结成了友谊、:
In truth, despite the barrier his appearance put up, Manato was popular with everyone.
Some made friends with him, some looked to him for protection, and some... tried to rope him into advertising.
"Sorry, I'm probably not the right choice to promote your shop."
"As for 'bench pressing,' I've never done it — unless you're referring to... being pinned by Ethereals and pushing up my greatsword to keep their claws off me?"
于深夜星辉之下，匠人手持此器，唤醒沉眠的火焰。夜色朦胧中，唯此燔火不熄。\n通体:
Under the stars at midnight, the artisan raised this tool, awakening slumbering flames. Amid the misty dark, it was the lone flame that refused to die.
Its body gleamed black with a crimson sheen, etched with cryptic markings. Was it an ancient relic, a mere toy, or a legendary weapon? Only its wielder knew the truth.

"It's nothing more than a fire-starting tool... but I can't deny it's useful." —So he would say, each time someone guessed it served some impressive function.
云岿术法外可御以太流动，内可护经络筋骨。气劲如盾，刀枪不入，这便是潘引壶硬扛攻击:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.
亲卫队小猪发动[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]时，为露西回复2点能量，\n15秒内最多: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.
人人都说对空六课聚集了一帮怪人和天才，其中唯一的「正常人」便是月城柳了。\n但也: Everyone says Section 6 is gathering oddballs and geniuses, with Tsukishiro Yanagi being the only "normal" one. But it's precisely her presence that holds the oddballs and geniuses together.
人总是在被人在乎的时候说谎，却又在被人遗忘的时候吐露真相。\n这些不明智的抉择总:
We lie when others still care about us, and only tell the truth once they've stopped.
Such foolish choices always lead to regret. My job is simply to use yesterday's regrets to make today's a little lighter.
I know people always lie, but at least there are still some who bother to lie to me.
"My suggestion? Mix a bit of flattering nonsense in between your insults — it'll work in your favor~!"
人类原来是这样复杂的存在。\n一辈子可以有这么多的欢喜，有那么多的悲伤。\n可如:
So this is what humanity is — such a complex existence.
A lifetime can hold so much joy, and just as much sorrow.
Yet now, all of it has fallen into this void, to be swallowed, erased, and buried.
No one will ever care again for those joyful laughs, or those grief-stricken cries.
Still... every one of those untold stories has been etched into this abyss of the soul.
什么是骑士呢？\n赤红的骑士说——贯彻心中的正义吧！\n澄黄的骑士说——细数世间:
What is a knight?
The Crimson Knight says, "Carrying out the justice in my heart!"
The Amber Knight says, "Dealing with each sin in this world!"
The Verdant Knight says, "Protecting everyone's hope!"
So what is a knight, in the end? The advanced tactical construct suddenly falls into serious thought over this profound question, no different from the philosophers who have long pondered the ultimate meaning of existence.
Regrettably, this great and noble meditation on chivalric aesthetics is cut short in under ten seconds by an unceremonious interruption from a companion.
"Billy, you've watched 'Starlight Knight: A Knight's Proof' a hundred times already. So what even is the proof?"
"I'll know when I've watched it another hundred times!"
— Two people arguing over the remote at the Cunning Hares' base.
什么都会一点只能叫平庸，但在情况复杂多变的空洞作业现场，多一个技能有时就意味着多: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but in a complex and ever-changing Hollow worksite, having a wide skillset can present an opportunity to overcome difficulties.
什么都会一点只能叫平庸，但如果你足够坚定，从「会一点」变成「很擅长」，那你就是全: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but if you are resolute enough to change from "knowing a bit" to "being excellent," then you become omnipotent!
仅能通过拟态单质触发合成反应，重构生成的特殊卡牌。金色的牌面勾勒着恶魔布那诱人的: A special card created through a synthesis reaction triggered exclusively by Mimic Substances. The golden card face traces the alluring curves of the Devilboo. Deal me in~ Little Bangboo, buckle up for a ride to the Enigma of the Labyrinth.
仅能通过拟态单质触发合成反应，重构生成的特殊卡牌。银色的牌面映照着天使布那圣洁的: A special card created through a synthesis reaction triggered exclusively by Mimic Substances. The silver card face reflects the pure, holy radiance of the Angelboo. As for the Y-shaped symbol on the back, opinions are divided among the research station staff...
从幻境的报刊亭刮刮卡中刮出的门禁卡，或许对应的门禁区域就藏匿着刮刮卡的奖品？: An access card scratched from a scratch card at a newsstand in the illusion. Perhaps the prize is hidden somewhere within the area it grants access to?
从狭窄的通风口看到的那个女孩，闪亮得就像是从童话书里走出来的一样。\n她才是真正:
The girl I saw through the narrow vent shone like she'd stepped right out of a fairytale.
She was the real princess — and I was just a prisoner.
Lord, she has so much already... would it be so wrong if I had just a tiny bit of it too?
That's when the hairpin silently fell.
从空洞中搜集来的机密资料主机，似乎来自防卫军的某支队伍。禁止偷偷查阅，偷看也只能: A classified data terminal recovered from the Hollow. It appears to have belonged to a Defense Force unit. Unauthorized access is prohibited. But if you absolutely must peek, make it quick!
从精锐到楷模是一次漫长的跨越，但「11号」依然咬牙坚持着，似乎暗中有些什么理由一: The road from elite to exemplar is long and difficult, but Soldier 11 grits her teeth and perseveres, as if there's something pushing her towards the goal of becoming a perfect soldier...
从背后攻击命中敌人时，猫又无视目标16%物理伤害抗性；\n敌方处于失衡状态时，猫:
When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's Physical RES.
If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
从被南宫拉出门，到在那张合同上签好名字…对少女来说，这一天过得如同夏日划过雨夜的:
From being dragged out the door by Nangong to signing her name on that contract... to the girl, the entire day passed as swiftly as a flash of summer lightning cutting through a rainy night.
Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.
—This overwhelming delusion descending upon her was the most incredible gift she had ever known.
他们说，深渊里开出的花必然浸透恶意，就像有毒的树上结不出无毒的果。\n但所有果实:
They say that the flowers that bloom in the abyss are always soaked in malice, just like how a poisonous tree can't bear safe fruit.
But all fruit falls.
So, he broke himself into a rain of shattered pieces.
The rain covered the earth, and each dewdrop reflected a fresh new dawn.
他们说，猫有九条命，所以可以肆意攀上最高的屋檐。\n她也总爱踮起脚尖，任凭一脚踏:
They say cats have nine lives, so they can climb the highest rooftops without a care.
She likes to walk on tiptoe too, and if one step finds nothing beneath it, the long fall is merely another unremarkable adventure.
Following the trail of clues danger leaves behind, she keeps moving forward, with the end of the story forever out of reach.
他欣然走向无尽深渊，任由满地荆棘划破伤口。\n血色蔓延处，破碎的尊严与执念自创口:
He walked willingly toward the endless abyss, letting the thorns on the ground tear at his wounds.
Where the blood spread, broken dignity and stubbornness began to sprout from the wounds.
He picked up the blood-soaked thorns to crown himself.
"There's only ever been one person who can kill me or save me... And that is me."
他的举手投足总是充满从容，他的言谈举止让人如沐春风。执事的教养就是让一切都在掌握: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.
他的眼神暗藏野性，他的喉间滚动嚎音。不论现在的他如何优雅，礼服下的他依然凶猛。: His glance harbors a primal ferocity, and the echoes of his howls rumble within his throat. Regardless of his current gracefulness, underneath the formal wear, he's still untamed.
代理人[围杀]状态的增益效果生效时，该代理人造成的伤害无视20%防御力；\n发动:

仪玄是云岿山第十三代门主，也是被市长梅弗劳尔亲自认可的虚狩级调查员。\n\n她曾:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower.

She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.

After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.

伊德海莉，除了代理人的身份外，也兼任绳匠以及怪啖屋的投稿作者。\n在其他人看来，:
In addition to her role as an Agent, Yidhari doubles as both a Proxy, and a contributor for Spook Shack.
To most, she comes across as laid-back and leisurely, but according to records, it's less "laziness" than a shroud of nothingness, leaving her at odds with the world around her.
Perhaps to most people, this would seem like the usual quirk of someone absorbed in their craft. As a gifted writer of bizarre tales, Yidhari should be more prone than most to immersing herself in the worlds of her own imagination.
In truth, however, her unusual behavior stems more from the burden of her own abilities.
In the Hollows, she's exposed to vast torrents of information unimaginable to most, tangled with years upon years of memories that have amassed there. That crushing weight of countless pasts constantly batters her sense of reality, until even her emotions are gradually worn dull.
The fact that she can bear this burden, turn it into her own strength, and still live life in her own way — that's what sets Yidhari apart as gifted beyond others.

克拉蕾，弗林特工坊的工坊主与现任家主，传奇辉金锻造师。\n\n极富家族荣誉感与责:
Claret, owner of Flint Workshop, the current head of the Flint family, and a legendary Porcelloy smith.

She has a strong sense of family honor and responsibility, and deeply treasures Porcelloy, her family, and the smithing techniques passed down through generations. For that very reason, she despises any act that wastes Porcelloy or causes it to be needlessly consumed.

Roscaelifer's daily operations rely on Porcelloy, and the Flint family is the source of all Porcelloy in the world. Naturally, this makes Claret the greatest "creditor" of the Celestial Nexus. Though she holds leverage powerful enough to shake the heavens, she never uses it to demand greater power or status, instead abiding by the ancient family's original oath.

Claret may appear aloof, but she doesn't act high and mighty just because she's the family head. People who know her tend to find her easy to get along with. She's bad at being honest about how she really feels, often saying one thing while meaning another, and she's quick to give in to other people's requests, even if it puts her in an awkward position.

初次下厨时，他差点把灶台点着。赶来救火的人里有个厨子，看着那堆烧糊了的食物，把还:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

千夏是「妄想天使」偶像组合的成员之一，同时也是团队发行所有音乐的作曲人。既要保证:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"

Lucia, a member of Spook Shack, goes by the online name "Night Emissary." She's a backpacker, an Ethereal story enthusiast, and a connoisseur of late-night food stalls.

Records show that Lucia hails from a tribe living on the outskirts of the city. Legend has it their ancestors once encountered an Ethereal called the "Night Horror" (absent from the Hollow Investigative Association archives), which left them with a strange gift: Ethereals tend not to notice them. The cost, though, is that they dream of the Night Horror at night, and under its influence, they sleepwalk into Hollows, where corruption awaits.
Because of this, the tribe took on the role of Nightwatchers. They rest during the day and hunt deep in the night, avoiding the Night Horror's pull. And if anyone must sleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.

Ye Shunguang is the Sword Keeper of Yunkui Summit's treasured Qingming Sword, a disciple of Yixuan, and the younger sister of Ye Shiyuan, as well as a swordswoman blessed with extraordinary talent.
She enjoyed a happy childhood until the fall of the old capital, when her parents lost their lives rescuing others, bringing all her happiness to an abrupt end.
From then on, she relied solely on her brother — up until Yixuan took them in, bringing them into Yunkui Summit. Later, she was chosen by the Qingming Sword, taking up the mantle and duty of Sword Keeper.

Rumor has it that the Qingming Sword's favor is less a blessing and more a kind of curse. Though it gives its Sword Keeper Void Hunter level power, it extracts a harsh cost — the loss of one's memories and five senses.

Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.

奥菲丝·马格努森，隶属新艾利都防卫军·黑曜石营·奥波勒斯小队，是枪械形态的智能构:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."

The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"

女孩将名字写进逐日者的行列，因为她怀抱着比骄阳更炽烈的理想。\n她相信伤痕将被弥:
The girl wrote her name among the Sunseekers, driven by an ideal that burned brighter than the blazing sun.
She believed every wound could be healed. She believed every sacrifice could one day come to an end. And so, she turned and walked into the secret garden.
She did not yet know that, deep within that garden, time forever diverged, leading to countless futures.
Some led to glory. Some led to hope...
Others led to the shadow cast by the sun, to a long night that no one would remember.
"I know, I know. But someone's gotta do it, right?"
她仍向深夜索要一场盛大的坠落，仍喜欢听见风从耳畔撕裂而过；\n她仍旧拥抱荆棘，任:
She still asks the dead of night for one grand fall, still loves the sound of the wind tearing past her ears.
She still embraces the thorns, letting the world's sharp edges pierce her flesh, letting her blood follow the tracks of days gone by into the abyss.
But this time, the thorns don't fall back into the soil.
Someone barges into her little garden without so much as asking, picks up the branches she's left behind, winds them around the gate and window frames, and builds a crooked little fence. Then they stand before her, blocking the desolate path ahead.
She hesitates time and again, but finally takes a step back.
她在跌入深不可测的秘境。\n——这里是何处，又将跌向何方？\n心下生出这份疑惑时:
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.
她将自己淹没在工作之中。\n调查，审讯，裁决，几乎无穷无尽。\n同伴担忧地望着她:
She buried herself in her work.
Investigations, interrogations, judgments... an endless list.
Her colleagues watched her with concern.
"How long are you going to keep this up...?"
"Until every last sin is atoned for... or until death takes me."

She became an exceptional Sweeper — swift, precise, and silent. Her targets were clear and countless: Ethereals, those infected with irreversible Corruption, those fated to turn into Ethereals... every kill marked by bloodshed and the echoes of their cries.
But... is it right?
"This is a Sweeper's duty!" "Just think of it as... for the greater good, got it?" "Those people were going to die anyway." ...
"It's a necessary sacrifice."
她无法拒绝完美的对称。\n对称之中，存在着秩序与规律。若看不到对称，她的兔耳和尾:

"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"

She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands, she raised Roscaelifer's very first wall.
She was Roscaelifer's first blade broken. Her family name was de L'Azur.

She has reached the end of life countless times. There is no town above the clouds, no scarecrows who have lost their hearts. There is only a towering wall, asking if she would trade her shadow and her heart for eternal peace.

Roxy Ifrita Pryce, the resident manager of Flint Workshop, is a close friend, assistant, housekeeper, and problem-solver to Claret, head of the Flint family.

Unlike stereotypical "geniuses" like Claret and Norma, Roxy considers herself merely an ordinary hard worker, barely keeping pace with true geniuses through sheer time and effort.

Setting aside her modesty, the sheer amount of time and effort Roxy puts into Flint Workshop each day is indeed far beyond what could be considered healthy, which has, to some extent, worsened the paleness caused by her heart condition.

Roxy is usually remarkably steady. Even among the many Agents, she ranks near the top in both operational efficiency and consistency. According to Roxy herself, that's because "milady gets into more than enough trouble," and such an unusual work history has taught her to remain unfazed in the face of any crisis.

Ukinami Yuzuha, a resident of Waifei Peninsula's Failume Heights, currently attends a low-tuition company affiliated school in the city. Aside from being part of the Inter-Knot subforum Spook Shack, she's not affiliated with any other groups — though in New Eridu, such forums aren't typically seen as formal organizations, and are, instead, more like hobby clubs.
Yuzuha is the adopted daughter of Li Baorong, owner of the Mystic Wares Porcelume store. Word around Failume Heights is that Baorong lost his wife and two daughters when the old capital fell. In the years that followed, he took in five children. Yuzuha is the second oldest, with an older brother, a younger brother, and two younger sisters. The family lived on the second floor above the store, and with just two bedrooms, Yuzuha shared one with her sisters, while the boys stayed with Baorong. Now that her older brother has moved out and she mostly stays in the school dorm, the apartment feels a bit less crowded. But on weekends and holidays, Yuzuha usually returns from school to help her father at the store.
Even as a child, Yuzuha showed a surprising level of maturity. Her eloquence and cheerful nature have made her a favorite among neighbors — and a hit with the kids around Waifei Peninsula and Sailume Bay.
On the Spook Shack forum, Yuzuha goes by the username "Yuzupepper." In addition to her real-life friends Manato and Alice, she is also close with two other users known as "Night Emissary" and "Strawberry Parfait" on the forums.

Zhao, a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge, was one of the elite members who joined in the early days.

It's said this mindset didn't come from Zhao's work at Krampus, but had already taken root during her childhood. She evaluates not only others, but herself as well. "Only those with value deserve to be seen."

The wind roars in her ears, her blood surging hot within her chest.
Something is trying to burst free. Something is struggling awake.
She loves this feeling.
Nothing remains worth fearing, just as nothing remains worth pursuing.
A spark of life lies buried within that fragile body. Whether it bursts into flame or dies away, it's only waiting to burn anew.

The lighter life is, the more freely she longs to spend it. The shorter it is, the brighter it must burn.

Komano Manato, a member of Spook Shack and an exceptionally reliable person. Having lost his family in the fall of the old capital, he grew up alone in Waifei Peninsula until the day he happened to adopt two street children, A-Cing and A-Yuet. Since then, the three have lived as a family, depending on one another. It may be a young household, but to Manato, nothing matters more than looking after them.
Manato is currently enrolled at a company affiliated school in the city, where rumors paint him as the terrifying "school delinquent." The label likely comes from his intimidating appearance, though in reality, he's far more soft-hearted and generous than he seems.
At first, Manato really did want to do something to clear up the misunderstanding about being a delinquent, but for various reasons, his efforts didn't make much of an impact. Still, his optimism soon led him to realize that the title wasn't all bad. It let him dodge unnecessary social events, live without being bothered by strangers, and even leverage the "delinquent" image to sniff out stories of school ghost tales, all while standing up for classmates suffering from actual bullying.
But when it comes to grades, he really does live up to the "school delinquent" label of a company affiliated school student.

珂蕾妲，白祇重工的现任社长。同时也是公司创始人霍尔斯的亲生女儿。\n父亲霍尔斯因:
Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers.
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.
Hypothesis: Koleda's comparatively smaller stature among her peers may stem from her prolonged involvement in the Hollows.
Currently, there aren't any publicly accessible papers or research substantiating this theory, but I will continue to track this topic.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows — a talent that's unmatched. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

维琳娜，外务筹策局的总务官，统筹着罗斯凯利法与新艾利都的往来协作事宜。\n\n作:
Velina, the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department, oversees cooperation and diplomacy between Roscaelifer and New Eridu.

As a descendant of the prestigious Airgid family, Velina inherited a strict and meticulous upbringing. Renowned for her nearly flawless efficiency and exceptional ability to keep any situation under control, she is the dependable adult whom Chief Technician Norma describes as someone capable of "handling meetings, paperwork, and troublesome people."

She is sharp and efficient in her work, meticulous, and always gentle and composed when dealing with others. Beneath her elegant, effortless smile lies an intensity that is impossible to ignore. No matter how troublesome the diplomatic affair or absurd the disaster may be, Velina can resolve it with ease. However, the price of seeking her help is not always one the requester can afford.

Velina has a particular fondness for all kinds of black tea and often invites friends to tea parties during her spare time.

Please note: Any tea party invitation sent by Velina in her capacity as Administrative Director should never be taken lightly. They are rarely mere leisure. More often, they serve as the perfect setting for her to negotiate situations and quietly steer events toward her desired outcome.
罗斯凯利法是天空的奇迹，而守护奇迹之人的头衔，绝不独属于少数人。\n但总要有人成:
Roscaelifer is the miracle of the skies, and the title of those who protect that miracle has never belonged to only a select few.
Yet someone must lead those guardians. That was originally Lady Lindverne's duty, but with her bright and carefree nature, she was hardly suited to be a commanding general.
Fortunately, she had a dashing deputy. More accurately, she had one after another.

The blazing sun rises through the Ether, and the golden flames that scorch the horizon cascade from the sky — so the composer wrote on the back cover.
置身于空洞内时，周围的一切以太波动都将成为她观测空间的助力。\n「曾经的我一直觉:
When inside the Hollow, every Ether fluctuation around her becomes an aid to her spatial observation.
"I used to think these eyes were cursed, bringing nothing but pain."
"But now... they're my ticket to reaching my goals, and proof that I haven't forgotten my past."

耀嘉音是公认的「丽都第一歌姬」，凭借其超凡的嗓音、舞台感染力和创作才华，引领了整:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.

般岳师父不止是武人，更是位智者——不管是武馆的学生们还是相熟的邻里，都这么说。\:
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."
般岳师父可有过什么欲求么，他在澄辉坪开着家武馆，似乎也只因为某位宗师提议他开家武:
Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

般岳，一位在卫非地开设武馆、门下学徒众多的智能构造体，存活于世已有很长时间，人称:
Banyue is an Intelligent Construct who runs a martial arts school in Waifei, known to many as "Banyue Shifu." He has lived for a long time, his stone-lion-like presence commanding respect. A martial arts expert of great skill, he shares a long-standing friendship with Yunkui Summit's current High Preceptor, Yixuan.

As a martial master, Banyue is quiet but dependable. His methods and beliefs are rooted in tradition, and he disciplines his students with strict yet thoughtful guidance, teaching them not just how to fight, but how to learn. Known as a true master of the martial arts, in battle, he can assume a special form known as the Visage of Wrath to vanquish all evil.

A long inhabitant of Waifei, Banyue is quiet and even-tempered. He doesn't express emotions easily and has the manner of someone from another era. Knowing he's out of touch with modern trends, he's been secretly trying to learn the latest internet slang... yet his half-baked grasp of it tends to end in funny little misunderstandings.

Banyue also appears to have a strange liking for round things — stone balls, spherical bollards, and the like. If the conversation ever goes silent while you're alone with him, bringing up something spherical usually does the trick.

Art can save those drowning in life. Mortals gather together, music of different emotions collide, and the drying graffiti on the wall speaks of a thousand unique forms of agency.
Now, turn up the music until the soundwaves crash the Hollow. Even if Ethereals don't have ears, let's make them feel the power of humanity!

Ellen is a maid working for Victoria Housekeeping Co. and its latest member.
She is a laid-back individual who dislikes activities that require energy. However, with the full support of her teammates, she can unleash her formidable power during critical moments.

Ellen attends a school in New Eridu and has a group of ordinary friends.

Soukaku is a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and currently under the guardianship of Section 6's Deputy Chief, Tsukishiro Yanagi.
Soukaku's birth records cannot be found in either the HIA archives or the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profiles. Her records only date back to when she started living with Tsukishiro Yanagi.
There are also no records of her schooling. According to supplementary information, Soukaku is currently homeschooled.

Soukaku is naive, innocent, and carefree, but she possesses an uncharacteristic obsession with food. Please be careful not to let Soukaku become too hungry.
At the same time, please do not let Soukaku see food being wasted. This is unacceptable behavior to Soukaku. Deduction: Soukaku has experienced famine before.

Soukaku's understanding of city life and human society is limited, and her view of life and death differs from most people.
Usually, Soukaku is willing to believe anything other people say, but that doesn't mean she can't tell when something is a lie.
In fact, prior data shows that unless one has the ability to run and hide on par with Section 6, it would be in one's best interest to avoid lying to Soukaku.

Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.

He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 1%, up to a maximum increase of 10%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

莱特，卡吕冬之子的常胜冠军，前雇佣兵。\n在外环，常胜冠军指团战中专门负责解决对:
Lighter, the Champion of the Sons of Calydon and an ex-mercenary.
In the Outer Ring, the Champion of a team refers to the one responsible for dealing with the opponent's strongest fighter in a gang fight, and they often need to participate in one-on-one duels. Their victory is crucial, as it brings glory and morale to the entire team.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."

A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.

Phoenix Reffaella, Krampus Judge and their secret ace.

Unlike the other Judges, Phoenix is rarely involved in the preliminary review and assessment process. She only steps in from time to time to handle particularly troublesome "judgments." If the leader decides Phoenix needs to be deployed, it generally means the situation is extremely serious, and the target will face the harshest punishment of all. Death is the only mercy Krampus has left to offer.

That's exactly why Phoenix is known as Krampus's sharpest and most secretive branch. Those in positions of power fear her very existence, yet most won't lay eyes on her until the day judgment comes for them, only to be stunned by how frail she appears.

Despite the weight of her role, Phoenix herself is lively and spontaneous, a little overly familiar, and endlessly curious. She never seems to tire of trying all kinds of thrilling and dangerous forms of "fun," even though it constantly puts her life at risk.

蕾米埃尔·丹，初代虚狩之一，曾经的节杖军中校，秘密组织达识结社的成员。\n据记载:
Remielle Dan, one of the first-generation Void Hunters, was formerly a Lieutenant Colonel in the Guard of Staves and currently a member of the secret organization known as the Covenant of Dayat.
Records describe her as a prodigy from childhood, capable of rapidly acquiring knowledge and mastering skills in nearly any discipline.
She was selected to join the Guard of Staves at a remarkably young age, was promoted directly to Lieutenant Colonel, and inherited the Void Hunter weapon, "Thaumiel." Fighting alongside Colonel Vike and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe, she helped drive back the Dark Wall, rose to fame through that decisive battle, and was formally awarded the title of Void Hunter.
During the classified operation later known as the Day of Silence, Remielle and Colonel Vike were both believed to have been killed in action following an unexpected incident. Yet as she's still alive, then the truth must be something else entirely.
Remielle comes and goes without a trace, yet always seems to appear at the most unexpected, pivotal moments, steering events in a new direction.
Around others, Remielle always wears a sweet, effortless smile. Calm under any circumstances and almost disarmingly friendly, she rarely gives people a reason to raise their guard.
She excels at closing the distance with lighthearted banter, yet instinctively maintains just the right amount of distance, making her difficult to read.
Note: Remielle has a habit of playfully teasing those around her. As for you, you seem to receive a particularly generous share of that "special treatment."

Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).

Flowing further and further...

这儿是一处盛大的、人头攒动的广场。\n比所有人都要高的台子上，有人叽里咕噜地说着:

"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."

This is just another break room in a military camp.

The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."
这儿是一所几乎无人知晓的、狭小的安全屋。\n零碎的、杂乱无章的东西填满了整个空间:

Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.

Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.

"Hey, I went through all that trouble to help you assemble that W-Engine, and you're using it to slack off here?"
